nodes.label: Composite Indexes for Multi-Column Queries
nodes.source_location: ## Create Composite Indexes for Multi-Column Queries
nodes.rationale: Two single-column indexes force the planner into a bitmap combination; one composite index answers the predicate in a single scan, claimed as 5-10x faster.

nodes.label: Leftmost Prefix Rule and Equality-Before-Range Column Order
nodes.rationale: A composite index is only usable from its leftmost column onward, so equality predicates must come first and range predicates last, otherwise the index cannot serve the query at all.
